::: {.column width="45%" .unwind-text}

I'm a Chennai girl at heart — city-raised, but with village roots running through me from grandparents who farmed the land, so I've got one foot in traffic and one in rice fields.\

When I'm not knee-deep in data or LCA models, you'll probably find me hiking a trail, baking something that may or may not survive the weekend, or nose-deep in a book.\

I'm equal parts biryani enthusiast and nature-documentary nerd (yes, I will tell you a random fact about octopuses unprompted), and I've got a serious soft spot for Tamil folk and street music — the kind that makes you want to get up and move.

:::
